summary: iteration_23 — Perform Hub v7 (app-native SoundMap Vitals show-time dashboard) verified end-to-end on preview URL. ALL 8 review criteria PASS: (1) Persona greeting eyebrow 'Hola 👋' (CSS text-transform:uppercase renders it as 'HOLA 👋') + persona-name h1 = 'The Warehouse Club'; streak-chip = '3 shows' with amber styling. Note: PersonaGreeting testId is overridden in perform-hub to 'perform-hub-title-wrap' so 'persona-greeting' is NOT present — used 'persona-name' as instructed by the review. (2) perform-freq-response line chart renders REAL PA response with 10 x-labels EXACTLY [31, 63, 125, 250, 500, 1k, 2k, 4k, 8k, 16k], 10 curve dots, LR24 slope visible; big value '152 dB máx' (arraySpl = 140 + 20·log10(4) = 152); extra 'Crossover 80 Hz · LR24' from calculateCrossover(tops, subs). MINOR: Y-axis renders only 4 of 5 requested ticks [-24, -12, -6, 3] — recharts auto-hides the '0' tick because ChartCardLine YAxis lacks `interval={0}` (ChartCardBar has it — same bug as iter_21). (3) perform-sessions-bar renders 3 bars [SET, FIE, WAR] (from scene names 'Setup Rehearsal', 'Field Test', 'Warehouse Show'), last bar highlighted bright lime (#C9F03E) vs dim (rgba(201,240,62,0.35)) on the other two; big value '158 dB' (8 tops seed = 140 + 20·log10(8) ≈ 158); extra 'Últimas 3 escenas guardadas'; Y-ticks [100, 120, 145]; delta chip '↑ 2 dB vs sesión anterior' with lucide-arrow-up icon and tone=bad (warm hue) because deltaPeak>0. Delta of 2 dB (not 6 as suggested in review) is mathematically correct: scene[i-1]=156 dB (6 tops), scene[i]=158 dB (8 tops), delta = last − previous = 158 − 156 = 2. (4) Split cards: perform-live-spl-card shows 'Ahora' / '— dB' / ProgressRing with Radio icon (lime accent). perform-compliance-card shows 'Compliance 100 %' + lime bar + '47 dB headroom' (152 − 105 = 47). perform-spl-meter-wrap contains SPLMeter component with mic controls. (5) Quick actions: perform-goto-export click → /export-page ✅, perform-goto-dsp click → /dsp ✅ (since dspUnits populated with LM 44), perform-goto-kiosk click → /kiosk ✅. (6) Empty state (localStorage.clear() + reload): page renders without crashing, persona-name = 'Show time', streak-chip count = 0 (NOT rendered because hasSystem=false), freq-response big value '—' + extra 'Cargá tops o subs' + x-labels still shown, sessions-bar big value '—' + extra 'Guardá una escena para ver el histórico', perform-goto-design fallback link visible at bottom. (7) NO fake weekly day-of-week labels anywhere: all rendered .recharts-cartesian-axis-tick-value elements = ['31','63','125','250','500','1k','2k','4k','8k','16k','-24','-12','-6','3','SET','FIE','WAR','100','120','145'] — zero L/M/J/V/S/D day-letter ticks; body text does not contain the L,M,M,J,V,S,D pattern. (8) Regression: Vitest 78/78 GREEN (all 5 test files: toolkit, rt60, engines, physics, optimizer-recorder — 78 tests / 5 files pass in 6.38s), tsc -b --noEmit exits 0, no real console errors on /perform navigation (only Vite HMR debug and React DevTools info).

Review explicitly asked for '-24, -12, -6, 0, 3' visible. Same class of bug as the SPL bar tick suppression fixed in iter_21. One-line fix: add `interval={0}` to the YAxis in ChartCardLine at /app/src/components/soundmap/vitals/charts.tsx line ~95-103, matching ChartCardBar at line ~48-49.

action_items: LOW-priority polish: Add `interval={0}` to the YAxis in ChartCardLine (charts.tsx line ~95-103) so all 5 yTicks render for perform-freq-response — matches ChartCardBar which already has this. Currently the '0' dB tick is auto-hidden by recharts. All other review criteria pass; this does not block release.
critical_code_review_comments: perform-hub/index.tsx L57 — PersonaGreeting is invoked with testId='perform-hub-title-wrap', so the default data-testid='persona-greeting' does NOT appear on /perform. The review flagged this correctly. Consider dropping the override and letting persona-greeting be the canonical testid, then adding an outer wrapper testid separately if needed for layout tests.
perform-hub/index.tsx L70 — an sr-only span with data-testid='perform-hub-title' duplicates persona-name for testability. Fine, but slightly redundant given persona-name already has a stable testid.

perform-hub/index.tsx L137 — the extra text calls calculateCrossover(tops, subs) a SECOND time in the JSX (already called inside useMemo at L31). Cheap function but conceptually redundant — either read xover.crossoverFreq from the useMemo or memoize the extra string.

system-vitals.ts L282 — sessionsPeakSeries labels use scene.name.slice(0,3).toUpperCase(). Scene names starting with the same 3 letters would collide visually. Consider using an index or the first initial of each word instead for future-proofing.
system-vitals.ts L268-272 — sort uses updatedAt ?? new Date(createdAt).getTime(). Correct fallback; no issues.

system-vitals.ts L278-280 — arraySpl uses Math.round after 20·log10(N). Consistent with paSummary at line 99 (which rounds to 0.1). The bar chart integer rounding is fine for a headline, but the delta comparison (latest − previous) may show ±1 dB step artifacts vs the paSummary display; not a bug, just cosmetic.

charts.tsx L95-103 — ChartCardLine YAxis is missing `interval={0}`. This is the SAME regression class as the SPL Y-tick suppression fixed in iter_21 for ChartCardBar (L48-49). One-line fix will make all 5 yTicks visible for perform-freq-response.

perform-hub/index.tsx L162-165 — When sessions.length === 0 the bar chart still renders one placeholder bar `{label: '—', value: 0, highlight: false}`. Verified empty-state works (bar collapses to zero height, no crash). Fine.

rca of the issue: Missing '0' yTick in perform-freq-response — RCA: recharts YAxis auto-hides ticks when `interval` prop is unset (default is 'preserveEnd'). ChartCardLine YAxis at charts.tsx L95-103 does not pass `interval={0}`, unlike ChartCardBar YAxis at L45-49 which does. Fix: add `interval={0}` to the ChartCardLine YAxis. Reproduction: navigate to /perform with seed data, inspect [data-testid='perform-freq-response'] .recharts-yAxis .recharts-cartesian-axis-tick-value textContents — will show ['-24','-12','-6','3'] instead of ['-24','-12','-6','0','3'].
